verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents invoice payment approval flows (jeeves-docs-27) and customizable roles and permissions for team members, including employee permissions on payments (jeeves-docs-22, jeeves-docs-29, jeeves-docs-37). Together these cover the core idea of designating teammates with payment permissions, but no documentation shows how payment-approval roles are configured or that approvers can approve and send in one click. Missing for 10: detail on configuring payment-approver permissions, evidence of a one-click approve-and-send action, independent or hands-on corroboration.
